A skyscraper? (\textbf{il grattacielo}.) A castle? (\textbf{il castello}.) A tower? (\textbf{la torre}.) A monument? (\textbf{il monumento}.) A statue? (\textbf{la statua}.) A plain? (\textbf{la pianura}.) A pebble? (\textbf{il sasso}.) Mud? (\textbf{il fango}.) Dust? (\textbf{la polvere}.) Smoke? (\textbf{il fumo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item a victory, a defeat, a championship, a player, a coach

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Plastic? (\textbf{la plastica}.) Sheet glass? (\textbf{il vetro}.) Cotton? (\textbf{il cotone}.) Wool? (\textbf{la lana}.) Silk? (\textbf{la seta}.) A victory? (\textbf{la vittoria}.) A defeat? (\textbf{la sconfitta}.) A championship? (\textbf{il campionato}.) A player? (\textbf{il giocatore}.) A coach? (\textbf{l'allenatore}.) A number? (\textbf{il numero}.) A sheet of paper? (\textbf{il foglio}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{il giornale}.) A magazine? (\textbf{la rivista}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{il dizionario}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
